history.origins:
Country/Region of Origin: China (Jiangsu Province, Huaian).
Time Period: Modern; widely played in Jiangsu, Anhui and nearby provinces.
Historical Development: Climbing game related to Zheng Shang You and Sheng Ji; scoring uses level promotion.
Cultural Significance: Very popular in China; tournaments broadcast on local TV.
timeline: Modern Era: Continues to be played worldwide
